coco_source: Official COCO 2017 person_keypoints_train2017 + train2017 images (images.cocodataset.org); Terms 3 permit COCO pre-training.

factor_synthesis.scope: Extra factors after unchanged parent crop/flip/photometry/personpaste0.35. Fixed strength law and RNG stream. No PETA residual calibration.

init_note: ImageNet-1K MAE -> MMPose ViTPose-L COCO 210e, transplanted into the L3 graph (20261015T2035_vitposeL_coco_grid24_L3struct.pt; position grid resized 24 -> 16 at load) -> this stage.
posetrack18_source: Official mmpose-converted PoseTrack18 annotations (download.openmmlab.com) + official image tar parts aa/ab (owner andriluk/schiele) from the Hyper.AI figshare mirror; the mirror is truncated, so only persons whose image exists are used. PLUS official PoseTrack 2017 frames from the MPI server (posetrack.mpi-inf.mpg.de, owner approval 2026-10-11) mapped to PT18 names (PT18 frame k = PT17 frame k+1, verified pixel-identical on 57 overlapping videos), placed under data/external/posetrack18_from_pt17 (20261011T2230_pt17_to_pt18_place.json).
purpose: Keypoint pre-training stage on COCO + expanded PoseTrack18 (COCO:PT18 75:25, as vit_pre_VITPOSEH_PT18x) for the transplanted ViTPose-L in the L3 graph (patch padding 0, cls token), before the L3+TR organiser fine-tune. ViTPose-H gained +0.0016 single from the same stage (e6 0.9023 -> 0.9039).
revision_note: New stage (v68). 10 x 48k at lr 5e-5 (ViTPose already trained 210 COCO epochs), drop at 8.
